summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2025.0 New Feature Introduction - Automatic Action Conversion ## Introduction Welcome to the new feature introduction video of Marvelous Designer 2025. In this video, we will explore the exciting new capability of converting action files from other software or platforms into action files that match the default virtual model of Marvelous Designer. ## Downloading Action Files To begin, you can use free files downloaded from Mixamo. Simply search on the website for the action files you need. Use keywords in the search box, then double-click to apply the action on the website to either the default model or the virtual model you uploaded. ## Checking Settings Once you have selected your action, check all settings, such as arm space and others, to ensure they fit your requirements. Then, click download, select the FBX file in the pop-up menu, and return to Marvelous Designer after downloading your desired option. ## Converting FBX Files Next, go to the top of the main menu. Here, the virtual model is automatically converted into an action. You will need to select the gender in the window, which corresponds to the virtual model gender of the action. After that, your action files can be stored and used for other virtual models. Open the downloaded FBX file and click convert. Marvelous Designer will automatically convert the FBX file into a software-adjustable MTN action file. This process is very convenient and easy. ## Saving Action Files Once the conversion is complete, click the save button and select the save path. Name the unpreserved action file and place it in the appropriate location. ## Using the Animation Editor Next, click on the bottom triangle at the bottom of the screen to open the animation editor. In the play area, click the right mouse button to select the range to be limited to the activity frame. This can set the starting and ending frames of the play area to the first and last frames with animation. To set the first frame, click the mouse button in the play area. You will see a list of all the action files in the play area that you have created previously. ## Opening Costumes Go to the main menu and click on 'Opening'. Click on the top line of the window, select the costume option, and click OK. In the pop-up window, select the current virtual model size and posture option. After wearing the costume, set the simulation quality to 'Animation'. This setting will help you record more stable and accurate animation simulation data. ## Recording Animation Click the record button and start recording the costume animation as the character moves. When the recording is complete, check if the costume animation is correctly recorded. ## Conclusion Now you can easily use the external animation file. The action file can also be used for a virtual model after joint printing. Please check the following tutorial for more details. ```
